sections.description: Introduces IMNM as an autoimmune disorder characterized by necrosis of skeletal muscle fibres with minimal lymphocytic infiltrates, outlines autoantibody associations such as HMGCR/SRP, compares statin‐induced versus drug‐induced forms, describes characteristic histological features and discusses speculative mechanisms by which GLP‑1 receptor agonists could trigger an immune response.
